== Introduction ==

To take over in air and cancel force drains. This is my air dare challenge. I want you to battle me in the air and just see what happens.

== Strategy ==

My strategy is very simple. Use hidden base to get out all of my systems. Use Wokling to pull out haven so I can deploy my starships with ease. Cancel force drains with rebel fleet, which I should be able to get out fast with the signal, my spies and hidden base. I use battle plan and hidden base to try to force people to come in the air so I can destroy them. If they do not come in the air then I will spread out my ships and force drain heavily. At the end I use all wings report in and I try to retrieve about 8 force.
